packageRules.description: Automerge minor and patch updates only after Renovate verifies the status checks, including artifact generation

Supply chain (MAIR-711): a new npm or crates.io release is only proposed, so only automerged, once it is 3 days old: compromised releases are usually pulled within 72 h. internalChecksFilter strict: no branch before that, the update waits in the Dependency Dashboard
Our own packages (OpenAPI contracts, bffs-lib, lib-components, mairie360_api_lib) are published by our CI and pinned right away (dev releases): no quarantine
Supply chain (MAIR-711): pin third-party GitHub Actions and container images by digest (the tag stays in a comment), so a moved tag cannot change what runs
Internal refs stay on their tags: mairie360/CICD moves with its cicd_version input, and the ghcr.io/mairie360 images are built by our own CI
Pinning a digest freezes what the tag already resolves to: no quarantine (it would leave the ref unpinned longer) and automerge, except in the production Dockerfile (last rule)
Group Rust minor/patch updates in one PR
Group TypeScript minor/patch updates in one PR
Resolve @mairie360 packages from the GitHub registry
The database and liquibase-migrations images are released with the same tag: bump them together in one PR

mairie360/CICD is pinned in cicd.yml, promote-staging.yml and promote-prod.yml (`uses:` ref and `cicd_version`): bump every pin of a repo in one PR so they never drift, and never automerge it: a CICD minor can ask the consumer for new files (v4.4.0 needs the promote workflows, MAIR-494)
No automerge for minor bumps of 0.x dependencies: they can be breaking before 1.0 (patches still automerge)
Automerge everything (majors included) in local dev files

customManagers.description: Track pins annotated with `# renovate: datasource=<ds> depName=<name>` on the line above (e.g. TEST_DB_VERSION in .cargo/config.toml)

The GDPR PR checklist (MAIR-295) pins mairie360/CICD twice in gdpr-pr.yml, at the `uses:` ref (github-actions manager) and in the `cicd_version` input: track the input too, so the mairie360/CICD group moves both in one PR. Each repo's renovate.json covers cicd.yml and the promote workflows.
